feature_development.label: Feature launch
feature_development.acceptance_criteria: Flow completes end-to-end, core regressions stay intact, and reviewers can verify output with clear evidence.
feature_development.context_background: Describe the user/problem, affected screens or APIs, and dependencies to watch during implementation.

learning_objectives.1: Assess autonomy while shipping a feature

bug_fix.label: Bug fix
bug_fix.acceptance_criteria: Bug is reproduced before the fix, no longer reproduces after the fix, and nearby regression checks are documented.
bug_fix.context_background: Describe symptoms, user or operational impact, reproduction steps, and suspected code or flow area.

code_review.label: Review package
code_review.acceptance_criteria: Review identifies important issues, separates must-fix items from suggestions, and leaves actionable rationale.
code_review.context_background: Describe review scope, primary risks, expected checklist, and the criteria that matter most in this review round.

qa_testing.label: QA pass
qa_testing.acceptance_criteria: Test checklist is completed, bugs or edge cases are recorded clearly, and results show whether the flow is releasable.
qa_testing.context_background: Describe test environment, regression scope, related features, and priority risks to verify.

test_automation.label: Automation coverage
test_automation.acceptance_criteria: Automated test runs reliably, targets the main risk, and provides pass/fail signal reviewers can trust.
test_automation.context_background: Describe the flow or risk to automate, expected test type, and conditions that could make the test flaky.

learning_objectives.1: Observe ability to turn tests into reliable signal

architecture_design.label: Architecture decision
architecture_design.acceptance_criteria: Proposal explains trade-offs, blast radius, recommended decision, and next implementation steps.
architecture_design.context_background: Describe the architecture problem, current constraints, options under consideration, and risk of no change.

learning_objectives.1: Observe trade-off reasoning and decision communication

authentication.label: Authentication
authentication.description: Login, sessions, access rights, route protection, and identity flow.
authentication.context_background: Task belongs to identity/auth. Describe system entry/exit flow, affected roles, and related guards or token/session behavior.
authentication.acceptance_criteria: Authentication/authorization flow works for happy paths and error paths, does not open permission gaps, and reviewers can prove behavior with clear checks.

marketplace.label: Marketplace
marketplace.description: Discovery, task visibility, application flow, public/internal opportunity surface.
marketplace.context_background: Task belongs to marketplace. Describe who sees what, eligibility conditions, and impact on application/discovery journey.
marketplace.acceptance_criteria: Correct users find correct opportunities, private tasks are not exposed, and apply/visibility flow is verified with clear scenarios.

learning_objectives.1: Observe privacy protection when opening data

review_dispute.label: Review & Dispute
review_dispute.description: Review session, fairness, evidence quality, dispute-safe workflow.
review_dispute.context_background: Task belongs to review/dispute. Describe which evidence is considered, who reviews it, and where fairness/governance risk sits.
review_dispute.acceptance_criteria: Review/dispute flow has clear evidence, status transitions are correct, and profile/governance side effects happen only under valid conditions.

learning_objectives.1: Assess evidence handling and state transitions

admin_console.label: Admin Console
admin_console.description: Moderation, support, platform governance, safety, inspection screens.
admin_console.context_background: Task belongs to admin console. Clarify whether this is platform-wide governance or moderation, not org/project delivery flow.
admin_console.acceptance_criteria: Admins see only correct platform-level data/actions, do not confuse them with org workspace, and action logs/guards are clearly explained.

learning_objectives.1: Observe safety and moderation boundary thinking

audit_logging.label: Audit Logging
audit_logging.description: Auditability, traceability, actor-action-object history, governance evidence.
audit_logging.context_background: Task belongs to audit/logging. Describe which events must be recorded, who needs lookup, and which governance flow depends on this log.
audit_logging.acceptance_criteria: Important events record enough actor/action/object/time data, can be searched in the correct context, and do not leak unnecessary sensitive data.

learning_objectives.1: Assess ability to turn actions into traceable evidence

quality_control.label: Quality Control
quality_control.description: Quality gates, release readiness, verification discipline, risk checks.
quality_control.context_background: Task belongs to quality control. Describe which gate is protected, the main risk, and who uses the verification result.
quality_control.acceptance_criteria: Quality gate is described clearly, verification steps are enough for pass/fail decisions, and results help managers/reviewers decide.

learning_objectives.1: Observe how checks become operational decisions
